name: BioUp.me: Put your links and contact details on one page in French, with QR codes to match

name: BrandPurl: Turn one product brief into a week of social posts with images and video

tagline: ArgenFields is a farmland map for Argentina and the United States that turns a plot into a technical report built from public soil and land registry data. It also carries farms for sale and rent and county data for US farming states.

name: AskNow Verify: Put a drag-the-puzzle-piece check in front of your sign-up form to keep scripts out
tagline: AskNow Verify is a hosted slider CAPTCHA for websites: visitors drag a puzzle piece into place before a form goes through. Your server then confirms each solved puzzle with a single-use token.

name: Auzmor: Assign staff training with due dates and see who has finished it
tagline: Auzmor is a learning management system for assigning and tracking employee training. It comes with a library of ready-made courses and apps for iOS and Android.

name: Calzivo: Work out how much gravel or loan you need before you pay for it
tagline: Calzivo is a collection of web calculators for money, building materials, health, dates and school math, with a few file and text tools beside them. Each calculator page shows the formula it uses and the assumptions behind the result.

name: CelebrateYou: Give someone a birthday song with their name and your shared memories in the lyrics
tagline: CelebrateYou makes a custom song with AI from a person's name, a memory and a wish you type in. The song comes as an MP3 with a lyrics sheet and a private gift page to share.

name: CiteReal: Check a reference list for papers that don't exist or have been retracted
tagline: CiteReal compares each entry of a reference list with records in scholarly databases and marks entries that cannot be found, carry wrong details or have been retracted. A second tool finds published papers for a claim you type in.

name: Clothes Swap: Try two shirts from your cart on the same photo of yourself and compare them
tagline: Clothes Swap redraws a photo of you wearing a garment from a second picture, or a complete outfit copied from a photo of someone wearing it. A slider compares before and after, and the result downloads as a JPG.

name: Duck City: Open shops and furnish homes in a growing village of ducks, with no way to fail
tagline: Duck City is a life simulation game for iPhone and iPad in which you open shops and bring ducks into a growing village. The save stays on the device and the game needs no account.

name: EarlyLore: See who already built your software idea and what they charge
tagline: EarlyLore is a research site with profiles of software products, their estimated website traffic and their pricing. You describe an idea or paste a URL and get a report on the products already in that market.

name: Ease Weather: Check the forecast and the usual weather for any month before you book or pack
tagline: Ease Weather is a weather website with hourly and 14-day forecasts for places worldwide. For each place it also shows what the weather is usually like in every month, which helps when a trip is still months away.

name: EditablePPT: Rebuild a slide screenshot or PDF as a PowerPoint you can edit
tagline: EditablePPT converts slide images, PDFs and existing presentations into PowerPoint files with real text boxes. Photos, icons and backgrounds are placed as separate layers.

name: GarageCalc: See how new tires or wheels change your car's fit and speedometer before you order them
tagline: GarageCalc is a set of browser calculators and reference tables for tires, wheels, towing, engine math and fuel costs. Every calculator shows the formula it uses, and vehicle data pages name their sources.

name: KaomojiBox: Find a Japanese text face for the mood and copy it into your chat with one click
tagline: KaomojiBox is a browser library of kaomoji, the Japanese faces built from text characters. You search or browse by mood, copy a face with a click, save favourites and make new faces with an AI generator or by hand.

name: LineSVG: Get line drawings from a prompt or picture, with lines you can still thicken and recolour
tagline: LineSVG generates line art from a text description or an uploaded image and saves it as an SVG file made of strokes. Width, colour and dashes of the lines can be changed after generation.

name: ManualFig: Turn a product photo into line drawings and numbered steps for a manual
tagline: ManualFig generates illustrations for product manuals, assembly guides and instructions for use from photos, CAD screenshots, sketches or step lists. Figures are changed by typed instruction and kept as versions in a project.

name: Notch Revenue: See today's Stripe revenue in your MacBook notch, with confetti when a payment comes in
tagline: Notch Revenue is a Mac app that shows today's and this month's Stripe revenue in the notch at the top of the screen. It reads the figures with a read-only key and marks each new payment with confetti.

name: Numalio: Check a percentage or an area and see the working behind the answer
tagline: Numalio is a set of web calculators for percentages, fractions, geometry and everyday money sums. Each page explains the formula with worked examples, in English, German, Spanish and Turkish.

name: OctaSapien: Check and compare the messages SAP systems send each other, in the browser
tagline: OctaSapien is a web toolkit for people who work on SAP projects. It combines small utilities for checking and comparing data with AI tools that draft test cases and project documents.

name: Orzella: Turn recipe links and screenshots into a cookbook you can search by ingredient
tagline: Orzella is a recipe book app for iPhone and iPad that imports recipes from websites, pasted text, photos and PDF pages. Saved recipes feed a meal plan and a grocery list.

name: Pactman: Check a US charity's tax-exempt status and sanctions record with one API call
tagline: Pactman's Nonprofit Check Plus API looks up a US nonprofit by its tax number and returns its IRS records together with a sanctions check. Compliance staff can get the same data as a report on the website.

name: PDF Shrink: Shrink a PDF on your iPhone or in the browser without uploading it anywhere
tagline: PDF Shrink is an iPhone app that makes PDF files smaller on the device, without sending them to a server. Its website adds PDF tools for merging and converting that run inside the browser.

name: PDF2MD: Pull the text out of a PDF as Markdown while the file stays on your computer
tagline: PDF2MD extracts the text of a PDF and writes it as Markdown with headings and lists marked. Files with selectable text are converted on your own device, and scans go through a separate text-recognition mode.

name: PetPedia AI Doctor: Ask about your pet's health and care in a chat that remembers the animal
tagline: A web chat for questions about a pet's health and daily care that works from a saved profile of the animal and earlier conversations. The site describes it as information and triage support that does not replace a veterinarian.

name: Photo Retouch Ease: Tidy up a portrait or repair an old photo in the browser, without the plastic skin
tagline: Photo Retouch Ease retouches portraits and restores old photos in the browser, and it can remove unwanted objects. You set the strength of the change and compare the result with the original before downloading.

name: Plexii: Keep each task's documents and web pages on one desk that reopens as you left it
tagline: Plexii is a desktop app for Mac and Windows that lays out each task on a canvas with its documents and web pages. It includes an office suite, mail, a calendar, team chat and an AI assistant that works from your files.

name: ReworkVideo: Fix the six-fingered hand in an AI video without generating the whole clip again
tagline: ReworkVideo repairs a short faulty stretch of an AI-generated video and keeps the rest of the clip as it is. You mark the frames or the area that went wrong and describe the fix, and the result can be compared with the original before you accept it.

name: ScholarMuse: Let your AI assistant look up real papers and research data instead of guessing them
tagline: ScholarMuse connects an AI assistant to public research databases, so it can search papers, check a reference list and fetch data on grants, genes, weather or the economy. It runs as an MCP server with a REST API beside it.

name: SciDraw AI: Describe a scientific figure in a sentence and get a drawing you can still edit
tagline: SciDraw AI generates scientific illustrations from a text description, a sketch or a reference image and opens them as editable vector layers. A separate chart tool turns CSV or Excel data into journal-style plots.

name: SendPhoto: Hand a finished shoot to your client as a private gallery link they open on any phone
tagline: SendPhoto is a web app that delivers photos and videos to clients as private galleries behind one link. Galleries can carry a password, a watermark, an expiry date and the photographer's own branding.

name: SharpNote: Notarize documents over a recorded video call, with the signer's ID checked first
tagline: SharpNote is a web platform where commissioned notaries hold remote online notarization sessions by live video. It covers the signer's identity check, signing and sealing on screen, the session recording and the journal entry.

name: UploadOff: Convert photos, PDFs, sound and video in the browser while the files stay on your device
tagline: UploadOff is a set of file converters for images, PDFs, audio and video that run inside the browser on your own device. After the first visit the site also works without an internet connection.

name: Use In Time: Get a reminder before the yogurt or the water filter passes its date
tagline: An iPhone app that lists food and household items with their expiry dates and reminds you before each one runs out. Items can be typed in or read from a photo of the product or a receipt.

name: VSDX.ai: Make editable Visio diagrams from spreadsheets, documents and whiteboard photos
tagline: VSDX.ai builds flowcharts, org charts and other diagrams from uploaded files or a written request. The result can be edited in the browser and exported as a Visio or draw.io file.

name: webchat.vip: Answer website chat and WhatsApp messages as a team from a shared inbox
tagline: webchat.vip collects messages from a website chat widget and from WhatsApp in an inbox the whole team works from. Rules decide which agent gets a conversation, and reports show how fast customers got a reply.

name: Word2MD: Convert Word documents to Markdown text in the browser, a whole folder at a time
tagline: Word2MD converts Word documents into Markdown, the plain-text format used by documentation sites and code repositories. The standard conversion runs in the browser, and the same converter exists as a command-line tool.

tagline: Xiaohua is a browser app for tingxie, the Chinese spelling tests of Singapore primary schools. A child hears a word, writes it by hand in grid boxes and sees how each character compares with the model.

name: AI SVG & GIF Generator: Shrink or resize animated GIFs and check SVG files without uploading them
tagline: Browser tools that shrink and resize animated GIFs, or clean SVG files and turn them into PNGs. AI generation of SVGs and GIFs is announced for later.

name: bakodo.jp: Make barcodes and QR codes at exact millimetre sizes and print them on label sheets
tagline: bakodo.jp is a browser tool in Japanese that makes barcodes in 111 formats and QR codes, sized in millimetres. It prints batches on A4 label sheets and writes commands for Zebra and TSC label printers.

name: BetaNeon: Browse new apps and public betas by category, or put your own product up for review
tagline: BetaNeon is a directory of new apps, early products and public betas, sorted into categories and tags. Makers submit through an account, and each listing is checked by a person before it goes live.

name: BPM Finder: Find the tempo and key of a song from the audio file, in your browser
tagline: BPM Finder measures the beats per minute and musical key of an audio or video file inside the browser. A studio area adds song recognition and an AI agent that turns a reference track into a brief for new music.

name: CalcaTools: Work out prayer times or zakat next to everyday sums like a mortgage payment
tagline: CalcaTools is a website with hundreds of browser calculators for everyday sums, plus Islamic and Hindu calendar and ritual calculators. It also has small tools for text, images, PDFs and code.

name: Central Alberta After Dark: Find platonic friends who are awake when your night shift ends
tagline: A friends-only community for night-shift workers and night owls in Central Alberta, Canada. Members find each other by schedule and interests, on the web or in an Android app.

name: ClipNoter: Turn a lecture or tutorial video into notes with timestamps and the slides that matter
tagline: ClipNoter turns an uploaded video or audio file into a summary, key points and timed sections, with the full transcript. A second mode adds still frames from the video next to the matching section.

name: ComicIdeas: Turn one sentence into a comic with the same characters in every panel
tagline: ComicIdeas writes a comic script from a one-sentence idea and draws the panels from character sheets. Speech bubbles and captions stay editable, and finished comics export as images or as print-ready PDF and CBZ books.

name: ContentPin Studio: Draft an illustrated blog post for WordPress and turn its images into Pinterest pins
tagline: ContentPin Studio writes illustrated article drafts from a topic and sends them to a self-hosted WordPress site. It then turns the article's images into Pinterest designs you can download.

name: Creepless: Sort each client request into included work or a paid extra before anyone starts on it
tagline: Creepless checks client requests against the scope agreed for each client. Work that fits goes to the team, and extras become quotes the client approves first.

name: Cutroom: Edit a video by describing the cuts in a chat, and check the plan before it renders
tagline: Cutroom is a browser-based video editor that takes instructions in plain language. It turns them into a list of cuts and captions that you check before anything is rendered.

name: EncodeKit: Turn Base64 strings and %20-filled web addresses back into readable text, or the reverse
tagline: EncodeKit is a set of web pages that encode and decode Base64 and URL percent-encoding. The conversion runs in the browser, with no account needed.

name: FoolFish Games: Play a quick puzzle, card or idle game in your browser, without installing anything
tagline: FoolFish Games is a browser-game platform with puzzles, card and board games, word games and idle clickers, many of them made by the studio itself. Games open in the browser, and an optional account syncs favourites and some saves.

name: Framed for Us: Turn one portrait each into six AI photos of the two of you somewhere you'd love to go
tagline: Framed for Us makes AI couple photos from two separate portraits, set in a destination you choose. A finished story holds six images and a photo strip, shared through a private gift page.

name: FrameWipe: Erase burned-in subtitles and on-screen text from videos, or blur faces, offline
tagline: FrameWipe is a desktop app for Mac and Windows that paints burned-in subtitles and text out of videos and photos. It can also hide faces, and the work happens on your own computer.

name: Hanashi: Book a video call with someone who shares your interests, with live translation
tagline: Hanashi books paid one-to-one video calls with hosts chosen by their interests, with live captions and translation. Hosts pass a short interview before they can take calls.

name: Headcanon Maker: Get small invented habits and backstories for the characters you write about
tagline: Headcanon Maker writes short invented details, pairing ideas, dialogue and backstories for fandom and original characters from a name and a few traits. Results can be edited, and characters can be saved to a private library.

name: Image Aspect Ratio: See a photo's exact aspect ratio and how it would fit a square or story frame
tagline: Image Aspect Ratio reads a photo's pixel size in the browser and shows its exact ratio, with Fit and Fill previews in common frames. Further calculators cover target sizes, video, ultrawide screens and square crops.

name: Locseek: Find a file on your Mac by its name as you type, even when you forgot the folder
tagline: Locseek is a Mac app that finds files and folders by name while you type, across the Mac, external drives and network storage. It runs offline and needs no account.

name: Look Morph: See a new hat or haircut on your own photo before you buy or book it
tagline: Look Morph redraws a portrait of you wearing an outfit, hat, bag, shoes or pants from a reference photo, or with a new haircut. A finished look can become a short GIF that turns the outfit to show its side and back.

name: Lumi: Describe a website or web app in a chat and get it built, with logins and a database
tagline: Lumi builds websites and web apps from a chat description and sets up the database and user sign-in behind them. It runs in the browser and as an app for iPhone and Android.

name: MapToSite: Give your shop a phone-sized web page that shows prices and opening hours
tagline: MapToSite builds a one-page mobile site for a local shop from its name, phone, hours and price list. A pasted Google Maps link adds the shop name and a Directions button.

name: Media to Words: Get the words from a Reel or your own recording as editable text and subtitles
tagline: Media to Words turns the speech in a public Instagram Reel or a saved audio or video file into text with timestamps. Saved files are transcribed inside the browser, and results export as TXT or SRT.

name: Mingzi: Write your name in Chinese, or find a real Chinese name that suits you
tagline: Mingzi spells English names in Chinese characters with pinyin and keeps a directory of real Chinese names with their meanings. A paid service picks three personal names, chosen by an AI with fixed checks or by a native-speaking expert.

name: MouseTestLab: Find out in your browser whether a mouse button double clicks or the wheel skips
tagline: MouseTestLab is a set of browser tests for a computer mouse: buttons, scroll wheel, double click faults, polling rate and DPI. Click speed tests for gamers and a few keyboard checks sit alongside.

name: NameOk: Check if your business name is taken as a domain or handle before you print cards
tagline: NameOk looks up a business name in domain registration records and on five social networks. A third section searches the App Store and Google Play, and each source shows its status as it finishes.

name: NomadBurn: Work out how many months your savings last in a remote-work city before you move
tagline: NomadBurn is a browser calculator for remote workers who plan to live abroad. It weighs your savings and income against a city's living costs and shows how many months the money lasts.

name: NotchMuse: Keep the lyrics of the song you are playing in view on your Mac while you work
tagline: NotchMuse is an open-source Mac app that shows the lyrics of the current song in the menu bar or beside the notch. It works with Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and Soda Music.

name: Ocr4you: Get editable Hindi or other Indian-language text out of a photo, scan or old PDF
tagline: Ocr4you reads text from scans and photos in Hindi, English and other Indian scripts and returns Unicode text, Word, Excel or searchable PDF files. Next to the OCR it offers free PDF and image tools that run in the browser.

name: OpenFirmList: Find manufacturers and suppliers by product or place, with each firm on a map
tagline: OpenFirmList is a search engine for companies, with AI-written profiles of manufacturers and suppliers shown on a map. You search by product or region and can tell makers from resellers with one filter.

name: Owner Packets: Make a branded monthly PDF report for each property owner from your rental totals
tagline: A browser tool that turns a prepared CSV of monthly property totals into a branded PDF report for each owner. A second included tool does the same for Jobber visit exports.

name: PermitCore: Sell your app with license keys that limit devices and unlock features
tagline: PermitCore issues and checks license keys for software that developers sell. It offers a REST API, eight official SDKs and a branded store linked to the developer's payment provider.

name: Petfinnly: Find a cat or kitten near you, from a breeder or for adoption, across the US
tagline: A US marketplace for cats and kittens where breeders and rescues post animals and owners can rehome their own cat. It also has a directory of shelters and rescues sorted by state.

name: PiSpace Sky: See which night this week is clear and dark enough for stargazing near you
tagline: PiSpace Sky scores the coming nights for stargazing in towns around the world, from cloud cover across the dark hours and the brightness of the Moon. It also shows Moon times, aurora chances, eclipses and space station passes, with an optional email alert for good nights.

name: Ponka Cat: Put every phone and computer you own on one VPN subscription
tagline: Ponka Cat sells access to encrypted VPN servers with no limit on devices or traffic. You copy a key from its web dashboard into a VLESS-capable app on your phone or computer.

name: RoomLook Lab: Restyle a photo of your living room or bedroom as Scandinavian or Mid-century
tagline: RoomLook Lab turns a photo of a living room or bedroom into an AI concept of the same room in a new style. It offers two styles and works as a style preview before you buy furniture or paint.

name: Sandwich AI Sales Trainer: Rehearse a tough sales conversation with an AI customer before the real one
tagline: A web app where salespeople rehearse customer conversations with a simulated AI customer and get feedback after each attempt. Managers assign practice and follow progress up to a final exam.

name: SimpleACME: Renew HTTPS certificates on your own without giving out your DNS account key
tagline: SimpleACME takes over the DNS proof step of automatic certificate renewal through one permanent CNAME record. You keep your current DNS provider, and your website and email stay where they are.

name: SplatLoom: Turn a short phone video into a 3D scene you can spin, on your own computer
tagline: SplatLoom is a desktop app that turns photos or a short video into a Gaussian splat, a 3D scene you can explore. It runs on Mac and Windows and keeps the files on your computer.

name: SpriteAI: Turn a description or a picture into animated 2D sprites ready for your game engine
tagline: SpriteAI turns a text prompt or a reference image into an animated 2D sprite sheet in the browser. Each export holds a PNG grid, single frames, a GIF and atlas data for game engines.

name: StateTaxLab: Work out your US take-home pay by state and see how each paycheck tax was calculated
tagline: StateTaxLab is a paycheck calculator for US wages that shows federal tax, Social Security, Medicare and state taxes per pay period. Each line opens the formula and the official source behind it.

name: StuffWatch: Get an email before the warranty or return window on a purchase runs out
tagline: StuffWatch reads a receipt from a photo and emails you before warranties and return windows run out. It also checks your things against official product recalls and reminds you about food best-before dates.

name: Tapline: Put a QR code or NFC tag on your packaging that opens a product page with a reorder button
tagline: Tapline links a QR code or NFC tag on a product's label to a mobile page with the brand's story and a reorder button. The page can be edited after printing, and scans are counted per code.

name: TattooStencil: Make a tattoo stencil draft from a photo and check it against the original
tagline: TattooStencil is a website that turns an uploaded photo or drawing into a black-and-white tattoo stencil draft with an AI image model. The draft opens next to the original for comparison, and you download it as a PNG.

name: TreadmillPace: Convert the mph or km/h on a treadmill into your running pace, and back again
tagline: TreadmillPace converts treadmill belt speed into minutes per mile or per kilometre, and a target pace into the speed to set. It adds an incline estimate and a printable pace chart.

name: Tutti Studio: Get editable notes back from a sheet music PDF made in a notation program
tagline: Tutti Studio converts PDF scores exported from Sibelius, Dorico, MuseScore or Finale into editable MusicXML. A check in your browser shows first whether a PDF can be converted.

name: TypeMorse: Translate text to Morse and back, and practise until you can read the beeps by ear
tagline: TypeMorse translates between English and Morse code as you type and plays the result as sound or light. It also decodes Morse from audio or images and has a Koch method trainer and a speed test.

name: UpLearn: Run staff training online and in the classroom, and keep one record of who passed
tagline: UpLearn is a learning management system for large organisations that handles online courses and classroom sessions, with an exam engine built in. It runs as a hosted service, on a private cloud or on the company's own servers.

name: VPS Plan Check: Compare small rented servers by specs, region and what you pay once renewal kicks in
tagline: VPS Plan Check compares small rented Linux servers from several hosting providers by specs, region and billing terms. A cost calculator works out what a plan costs over the months you need it, renewal included.

name: Poster.sh

name: Scan.now

name: Embedded Tools: Check firmware and video math in the browser, from Modbus checksums to camera storage
tagline: Embedded Tools is a set of nine browser calculators for electronics and video work, from Modbus checksums and CAN bus timing to H.265 file sizes. Each page shows the formula and a worked example next to the result.

name: Enlyo: Tag match footage while it plays and send players the clips that matter

name: Magic Dock: Swap the Mac Dock for one with widgets and a different Dock for each task

name: NAB Tools: Do small file and coding jobs with 140 utilities that run in your browser
tagline: A collection of 140 small browser utilities for PDFs, images, text and developer checks. Game makers get a separate set of calculators and planners.

name: Nexus Shell: Run your servers from a Mac: terminal, file transfers, Docker and live load charts
tagline: Nexus Shell is a native Mac app for logging in to remote servers over SSH. It combines a terminal, file transfers, Docker controls, SSH keys and live server charts, with an optional bridge for AI coding agents.

name: No Stairs Please: Find small venues and their booking contacts along your tour route
tagline: A map of small and mid-size music venues in the US and British Columbia, with booking contacts and the nights each room has music. A route tool lists the rooms along the road between your stops.

name: Nowah: Plan a trip from an idea or a travel reel and book the flights in the same chat
tagline: Nowah is an AI travel app for phone and web that turns a trip idea or a travel video into a day-by-day plan on a map. It searches and books flights and hotels in the same conversation and helps with visas and mobile data abroad.

name: Photo Timestamp: Print the date onto your photos so the album still knows when each one was taken

name: ProfessionalHeadshot.io: Turn phone selfies into dozens of business portraits for LinkedIn and your CV

name: Prompty: Get a full prompt for ChatGPT or Claude from a rough request, sent and checked for you

name: RoomFloat: See your own room with new floors or furniture before you buy any of it

name: RoomRestyles: Restyle a photo of your bedroom or rental in a new look while keeping your furniture

name: Savingy: See how much you can spend today and still make it to the end of the month
tagline: Savingy is a budgeting app for India that turns logged expenses into a daily spending figure. It also plans bills and loan repayments, on the web and Android.

name: Servero: Report sales to Meta, Google and TikTok from your own subdomain instead of the browser

name: Syaxis: Turn a topic or a stack of reports into a finished slide deck you can still edit

name: Timeview: See how old everyone in a Wikipedia article was in any given year, right beside the text
tagline: Timeview is a Chrome extension that lists the people linked in a Wikipedia article in a side panel with a year slider. It shows who was alive in a chosen year and how old they were, and exports the view as an image or video.

name: tShell: Run server commands, move files and edit remote configs from one desktop app

name: TukanCAD: Design a workbench or camper frame in 3D and get the cut length of every tube

tagline: Material-estimate toolkit with calculators for decks, concrete, paint and other home projects, plus a browser-saved project list and planning tools. Formerly ProjectMeasure.

name: WUYESTAGE LED Wall Calculator
tagline: Preliminary P3.91 LED-wall layout calculator on a supplier site. Estimates cabinet rows, columns, assembled size and pixel resolution for published cabinet formats and orientation.

name: Lora AI Image Generator
tagline: AI image and video workspace with model browsing, prompt/reference workflows and custom LoRA training. Model compatibility, credit costs and training access vary by workflow.

name: Hyperliquid Apps
tagline: Unofficial searchable directory of Hyperliquid frontends with dated builder-volume, revenue and average effective-fee comparisons. It does not hold funds or execute trades.

name: GeometryKit
tagline: Browser geometry editor for measured shapes, labels and worksheet diagrams. Switch between question and answer-key versions, with advertised PNG, SVG and editable-project exports.

name: Local File Metadata and Provenance Review Tool
tagline: Browser file-metadata viewer for educational privacy and provenance review. Displays available fields and structural indicators within parser limits, not an authenticity, AI-content or malware verdict.

name: Call Break Rule Checker
tagline: Interactive legal-card checker for the Clash of Cards version of Call Break. Select a hand and ordered trick to see follow-suit and winning-trump choices, with explanations.

name: Biodiversitas Nusantara
tagline: Indonesian-language biodiversity explorer with species pages, province comparisons and observation charts. The site attributes its data to GBIF; observation counts are not counts of species or animals.

name: VidBreak
tagline: Analyze permitted video sources into timed AI video prompts, story scripts or episodic screenplays. Public examples show outputs beside their source clips.

name: Scavenge.rs Scavenger Hunt Maker
tagline: Build browser-based scavenger hunts from your own clues, photo challenges and GPS checkpoints. Share a saved hunt link or code for guest play; keep browser access or link an account.

name: TradePaper Export Document Pack Generator
tagline: Prepare draft commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping marks and carton labels from one shipment form. Preview documents locally before printing or optional account saving.

name: Twitter Viewer by BeatAPI
tagline: Look up public X profiles, posts and replies in a browser, with advertised JSON and Markdown exports. Daily lookup limits apply; it does not require an X login.

name: AudioToMIDI
tagline: Browser audio-to-MIDI workbench with an interactive piano roll, timing controls and free 15-second sample exports. Full-track exports require an account and one credit per track.

name: 3D Print Pricing Calculator
tagline: Estimate 3D-print unit costs, markup, fees and batch quotes from manual inputs or local file parsing. Includes material waste, electricity, machine costs and active labor.

name: TIHMLO Password Manager Cost Calculator
tagline: Compare password-manager subscription estimates for one to six people, individual accounts or a family plan, and one to three years. Shows price assumptions and excludes unsupported options.

name: Same Spot
tagline: Compare two room photos with a before-and-after slider, alignment controls and a labeled comparison-image export. Includes an illustrated example.

name: Create AI Tattoo
tagline: AI tattoo-design studio with text prompts, style presets, body-placement proportions and reference-image Remix. Gallery images are inspiration, not finished tattoos or automatic try-on results.

name: The Chipmunks Dance AI Generator
tagline: Make a 15-second AI Christmas MP4 from an empty-room photo for Santa or one consenting adult photo for an elf dance. Generated sound and likeness vary. Children photos are not allowed.

name: WinningUGC
tagline: AI product-video workspace for planning ads from a product photo and brief, with staged creative directions, shot quotes, generation and editing. Free credits cover selected non-video work only.

name: PennyCompute
tagline: Prepaid video API for FFmpeg operations, Remotion rendering and MiniMax H3 generation. Public docs cover job submission, estimates, status and output retrieval.

name: China Calendar
tagline: Mainland China calendar with public holidays, make-up working days, lunar dates and a workday calculator. Full tools are in Chinese; the English page links to them. Independent, not a government service.

name: MomentRelay
tagline: Compare multiple cities on a 24-hour time zone board and share a meeting time.

name: Postdate
tagline: Share text and files through one link that opens at a date and time you choose. Until then, anyone with the link sees a countdown. Your browser encrypts the text and files before upload.

name: FocusPass: App Blocker
tagline: iPhone app blocker using Apple Screen Time, with timed access passes, protected schedules and focus sessions. A browser simulation previews the pass flow without blocking real apps.

name: Qoves AI
tagline: Portrait-analysis and style-preview tool with photo proportions, six-part reports and an AI styling assistant. Scores describe one photo, not health or objective attractiveness.

name: Useful MCP Hub
tagline: Hosted MCP connections for read-only Google Search Console reporting and IMAP/SMTP email. Mail tools can read messages, change read status and send plain text. Not an official Google product.

name: Insect Sound ID
tagline: Check whether a recording is usable for insect identification, then optionally buy a likely species, genus or group match. Results are educational leads, not expert or safety determinations.

name: Number Puzzles: Sumbriska
tagline: Flip numbered bridges until every island reaches its target sum. A free 20-board browser challenge accompanies the iPhone and iPad puzzle app.

name: Number Beasts: Bond Lab
tagline: Free browser number puzzle: aim a number at a beast to make ten, then plan where any leftover travels. Bond Lab offers staged boards and a daily challenge.

name: Lampstep: Bible for Real Life
tagline: iPhone and iPad Bible reflection app with everyday scenarios, verse-linked choices and short SOS readings. Uses Scripture for reflection, not medical or crisis care.

name: Wayfold: Understand the Bible
tagline: Bible study app for iPhone and iPad with chapter questions, verse-linked answers, maps and printable leader guides. Free web Ruth guides complement the app.

name: Hand On Web Image Compressor
tagline: Free browser image tool for JPEG, PNG and WebP compression, resizing and conversion. The publisher states files stay on-device. Review actual output quality and size rather than promised savings.

name: GetReelMaker
tagline: Credit-based image and short-video workspace with text, reference-image and first/last-frame modes. Clips can be edited into Reels, Shorts or TikToks elsewhere; model identity and output quality are unverified.

name: Compare Two Lists
tagline: Compare pasted lists for shared values, missing items and duplicate source lines. Offers whitespace/case rules and TXT, CSV and Excel import/export controls without an account.

name: KickClap
tagline: Selected meme photo-to-video presets with per-video pricing and 10- or 15-second clips. Most meme pages are guides, not generators. Review external-provider photo retention before uploading.

name: Chatwith
tagline: AI customer-support chatbot builder using business websites, documents and connected apps as knowledge. Offers a site widget, lead collection, human handoff and integrations, with features varying by plan.

name: 7 Deadly Sins Test: Which Sin Are You?
tagline: A free 21-statement entertainment quiz with seven independent sin scores, reverse-scored questions and case-file-style verdicts. Not a clinical test or a measure of moral worth.

name: 7 Deadly Sins Test: Find out which of the seven deadly sins pulls at you hardest, scored on a radar chart
tagline: A browser quiz that scores pride, greed, lust, envy, gluttony, wrath and sloth separately and plots all seven on a radar chart. Answers are scored on your own device, with no account.

name: AI Photoshoot Now: Get a themed set of nine portraits of yourself from one clear photo of your face
tagline: AI Photoshoot Now turns a reference photo into a series of nine AI portraits that follow one theme and one outfit. You pick a ready-made pack or describe your own theme for a solo series.

name: AuteurGraph: Follow a director's career on a timeline and find filmmakers linked to the ones you love
tagline: AuteurGraph shows film history as timelines of directors, movements, cities, awards and countries. A matching tool suggests filmmakers connected to your favourites and explains each link.

name: Business Ideas Atlas: Find the kinds of business that fit your spare hours and your dislike of selling
tagline: Business Ideas Atlas matches 102 business models to your budget, time, skills and appetite for sales. A short quiz ranks them, and filters and small calculators help you narrow the list.

name: CoinDesign: See your challenge coin in 3D metal and enamel before the factory makes it
tagline: CoinDesign turns front and back artwork into a double-sided 3D coin model with raised relief, previewed in metal and enamel in the browser. Designs export as GLB or STL files for a manufacturer or a 3D printer.

name: Compi: Plan a road trip or holiday with your travel group in one shared day-by-day itinerary
tagline: Compi is a trip planner where a travel group builds one shared itinerary of days and stays. It runs in the browser and on Android and iPhone, with an optional link to ChatGPT or Claude.

name: CostLoft: Estimate a roof or kitchen job for your state before the first contractor quote
tagline: CostLoft estimates what roofs, kitchens and other home improvement jobs cost in the US. Each calculator gives a typical figure with a low and a high end, adjusted to the state you pick.

name: EmailTimer.app: Put a ticking countdown and each reader's name into your marketing emails
tagline: EmailTimer.app makes countdown timers and personalized images for email campaigns, drawn when each subscriber opens the message. You paste a ready-made snippet into the email platform you already use.

name: Equal Earth Map: See countries at their true relative size and download a world map that keeps it
tagline: Equal Earth Map is an interactive world map in the equal-area Equal Earth projection, with a side-by-side Mercator comparison. World maps can be downloaded as PDF, SVG or PNG.

name: Every Exam Prep: Practise for a US licensing or certification exam, with every answer explained
tagline: Practice tests and study guides for licensing and certification exams, mostly in the US. Every question comes with a written explanation, and you can study without an account.

name: Faithful Kids: Give your kids short Bible story videos with a quiz after each one
tagline: Faithful Kids teaches the Bible to children aged 5 to 15 through two-minute video lessons from Genesis to Revelation. Each lesson ends with a quiz and a reflection question, and parents can follow the results.

name: Famed: Find out whether ChatGPT and other AI assistants name your business when locals ask
tagline: Famed checks every week how often AI assistants name a local business when people in its city ask for that trade. It shows which competitors get named instead and lists fixes for the Google profile and directory listings.

name: fandomgen: Get headcanons and short fanfic scenes for any fictional character you love
tagline: fandomgen is a set of AI card generators for fans, covering headcanons, ship dynamics, original characters and fanfic scenes. It works without an account and blocks requests for explicit content.

name: Festapp Tickets: Sell tickets for a ball or concert where guests pick their own seats, then scan them in
tagline: A web ticketing service where organizers draw their venue's seating plan and guests choose seats and dinner when they buy. Tickets carry a QR code that door staff scan with a phone.

name: FlickMS: Measure how fast you react, scored on the middle of five tries instead of one click
tagline: FlickMS is a browser reaction time test that scores five valid tries by their median. It shows your best try and how steady you were, and a challenge link sends a friend the same test.

name: Format Remover: Paste styled text from Word or a chatbot and get clean plain text back
tagline: Format Remover turns text pasted from Word, Google Docs, web pages or chatbots into plain text and keeps the paragraphs. It removes HTML, styles, stray spaces and hidden characters inside the browser.

name: ImageCombiner: Put two people or pets from separate photos into one natural-looking picture
tagline: ImageCombiner uses AI to blend two separate photos into one new image with matched light and perspective. Simple side-by-side and grid layouts run in the browser without an account.

name: Kidsome: Print worksheets with your child's name or this week's spelling words on them
tagline: Kidsome has 22 browser generators that turn names, word lists and number ranges into printable worksheets and charts. The site also offers coloring pages and puzzles to print.

name: MCPKit: Ask your AI chat about your Yandex ads and site stats, and let it make changes
tagline: MCPKit connects Yandex Direct, Yandex Metrica and Wordstat to AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude. You ask about ads, site traffic or search demand in a chat, and the assistant works with your own account data.

name: MSP Software: Compare the software IT service firms run on, with what other MSPs report paying
tagline: MSP Software is a directory of software for managed IT service providers, from ticketing and remote monitoring to backup and security. Listings combine vendor facts with reviews and price figures reported by MSPs.

name: My Faceless Reels: Post narrated vertical videos made from a topic or your own script, without filming yourself
tagline: My Faceless Reels turns a topic or a pasted script into a short vertical video with synthetic narration and captions. Finished videos download from a browser studio for posting on Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts or TikTok.

name: NeatCalendar: Print monthly calendars and planners as PDFs, with your own birthdays and shifts added
tagline: NeatCalendar is a website for printable monthly and yearly calendars and a 2027 planner, made as PDF files in the browser. A calendar maker adds your own events before you download or print.

name: OCRMind: Get editable text out of a photo or screenshot without uploading the image
tagline: OCRMind reads the text in an image, such as a scan or a screenshot, and turns it into an editable draft. Recognition runs in the browser, and the result can be copied or saved as TXT, Word or Markdown.

name: OneTwo Resume: Rewrite your old CV to match each job ad, and get a cover letter with it
tagline: OneTwo Resume imports your existing resume and rewrites it to fit a pasted job description. It also scores resumes and writes cover letters from a job link.

name: Paule.ai: Answer every new enquiry fast, even while the whole team is out on a job
tagline: A sales CRM for small teams that tracks each enquiry from first contact to signed contract. An autopilot follows up and drafts quotes, and an AI voice agent can take calls.

name: PDFBookmarks: Add clickable chapters to long PDFs and make scans searchable inside your browser
tagline: A browser-based PDF editor built around bookmarks: build or auto-generate a clickable chapter list, even for scanned books. About 30 more tools cover OCR, merging, compressing and conversion, with files processed on your device.

name: RideWise: Check whether Uber, Lyft or a taxi is cheaper for your trip before you book
tagline: RideWise estimates Uber, Lyft and taxi fares for one trip in US cities and shows them side by side. It needs no account and hands the booking over to the provider's app.

name: SEAL: Send files as encrypted links that expire, and see each time they are opened
tagline: SEAL encrypts files in the browser and shares them as links that expire, optionally behind a password or a single-download rule. Every open is written to a signed access log the sender can download.

name: ShareSpeak: Read your script on screen while you record or present, without it showing in the share
tagline: ShareSpeak is a teleprompter app for Mac and Windows that scrolls your script as you speak. The window stays out of screen shares and recordings.

name: Slot & Shaft: Resize a DIY desk or table in 3D and get the aluminum parts list that fits it
tagline: Slot & Shaft lets you resize furniture designs built from aluminum extrusion and see them in 3D. Each design comes with a matching parts list, cut lengths included, linked to US sellers.

name: Soliton: Confirm that a real person sits behind the selfie video in your sign-up flow
tagline: Soliton is a liveness check for online sign-up: it tells a live person in front of the camera from a recording or a deepfake. Businesses add it through an API, and users take a short selfie video in the browser.

name: StickPicker: Plan your 14 golf clubs from published specs and share the finished bag as a link
tagline: StickPicker is a website for putting together a set of 14 golf clubs from a large catalogue of models with published specs. The finished bag gets a shareable link, and club pages show new and used prices from retailers.

name: Suited for It: Find software from solo makers and small teams, or launch your own product there
tagline: Suited for It is a directory of software from independent makers, with buying guides and a daily launch calendar. Makers list their product from an account and see outgoing clicks in a dashboard.

name: Toolclove: Merge PDFs or shrink images without uploading the files anywhere
tagline: Toolclove is a collection of about 240 small web tools for PDFs, images, video, audio, spreadsheets and developer tasks. Most of them process your files inside the browser, with no upload and no account.

name: Vezur AI: Sharpen or enlarge a blocky video clip, and erase text burned into it
tagline: Vezur AI is a set of browser tools that reduce blur and compression damage in existing video or upscale it. Other tools cut out backgrounds and clear burned-in subtitles or watermarks.

name: VideoCompress.free: Shrink a video until it is small enough to send, without uploading it anywhere
tagline: VideoCompress.free compresses MP4, MOV and WebM videos inside the browser, so the file stays on your device. It saves the result as an MP4 at a preset quality or a target size in megabytes.

name: WinningUGC: Turn a product photo into a short vertical video ad for TikTok or Douyin
tagline: WinningUGC turns product photos and a short brief into vertical video ads for TikTok and Douyin. You approve the direction and a storyboard before any video is generated.

name: AI Room Makeover: See a new sofa or new curtains in a photo of your room before you buy
tagline: AI Room Makeover changes one object or surface in a photo of your room, guided by pictures of the product or material you have in mind. A separate workspace redesigns the whole room.

name: Alfalaki: Draw your birth chart from your exact birth time and place, and follow the sky day by day
tagline: Alfalaki calculates birth charts, two-person comparisons and planetary hours from astronomical tables, right in the browser. It adds daily horoscopes, a live star map and essays in English, French and Arabic.

name: Amnesia: Remember why you opened YouTube or X before the feed makes you forget
tagline: A Mac menu-bar app that asks why you opened a distracting app and keeps your answer on screen while you use it. Sessions are saved on your Mac and add up to a private daily report.

name: Animated Diagrams: Type how a system works and get an editable diagram that can play as an animation
tagline: Animated Diagrams turns a plain-English description into an editable diagram of boxes, arrows and decision paths. The finished diagram can play back as an animation.

name: Basklee: Run a store or a multi-seller marketplace from an admin panel, with your own storefront
tagline: Basklee is a hosted back end for online stores, marketplaces and blogs, with an admin panel, an API and file storage. The shop website runs on your own hosting, built from ready-made Nuxt, React or Svelte storefronts or your own code.

name: British Accent Generator: Turn a script into British-accented speech, from RP to Scottish, Welsh or Belfast
tagline: Text to speech with 315 AI voices labelled by UK region, from RP and young British to Scottish, Welsh and Northern Irish. You hear a sample before generating, and the audio downloads as a file.

name: CalcolaFiscale: Get an Italian tax code from your birth details, or check one you already have
tagline: CalcolaFiscale works out the Italian codice fiscale from name, birth date and birthplace in the browser. It also reads an existing code back and checks whether it is well formed.

name: CVTemplate Australia: Build an Australian-style CV in your browser and download it as a PDF
tagline: CVTemplate Australia is a browser-based CV builder with three A4 layouts made for Australian job applications. A second tool picks the selection criteria out of a pasted job ad and outlines an answer for each.

name: Decision Margin: Put numbers on a job offer, a move to freelancing or a big purchase before you decide
tagline: Decision Margin offers browser calculators and guided step-by-step checks for choices about money, time, jobs and creator income. The guided checks chain several calculators for questions like going freelance or taking a job.

name: DogWalkWeather: See when today's weather suits a walk for your breed of dog, and how muddy it will get
tagline: DogWalkWeather turns the forecast for a UK city into a walking verdict for a chosen dog breed, with an hourly timeline. A Muddy Paws Index shows how wet the ground is likely to be.

name: ExifStudio: Put your name into photo files, or wipe their hidden location data before sharing
tagline: ExifStudio edits or strips the hidden data in photo files, from GPS position to copyright, inside the browser. Side tools check a camera's shutter count and clean author fields from PDFs.

name: FinWaypoint: Find out how ready your Singapore company is for InvoiceNow before you pick a provider
tagline: FinWaypoint helps Singapore finance teams plan their move to InvoiceNow, the national e-invoicing network. A short readiness check scores six areas, and a date checker maps your GST situation to the published rollout phases.

name: GMBPoster: Keep your Google Maps business listing posting each week without writing the posts
tagline: GMBPoster writes posts for Google Business Profile listings with AI and publishes them on a calendar. It also drafts replies to Google reviews that you can edit before they go out.

tagline: AI receptionist that answers your calls 24/7. Books jobs or callbacks and texts you a summary. $197/mo, 7-day free trial.

name: NoUploadConverter
tagline: Convert files with 100% in-browser privacy & zero uploads. Fast, client-side PDF, image, video, and audio conversion directly in your device RAM.

name: Tesla Wrap Generator
tagline: Free AI Tesla wrap generator with model-specific templates, 3D car preview, photo-to-wrap design ideas, and Paint Shop-ready PNG export.

name: Fyno Adventure Trip Planner
tagline: Expert-curated adventure itineraries and AI-assisted trip planning for independent travelers on iPhone and iPad.

name: GenjutsuLite AI video scene recreation
tagline: Pick a scene. Make it yours. Browse 150+ AI video templates and order one personalized clip from $7.99.

name: RemakeWith
tagline: Photo-based AI video and image remakes using selected templates. Each video has its own production quote and photo requirements; outputs may change likeness, movement, clothing and scene details.

name: Design to Scale
tagline: Visual system-design course with 40 lessons covering requests, scaling, data, reliability and architecture. Step through diagrams and change illustrative model inputs. Practice and Quiz are still coming soon.

name: Shipmunks
tagline: Founder-learning site with practical guides, templates and 16 free SaaS calculators. Topics include hosting, development, AI tools, growth and operating metrics; examples and test writeups have stated limits.

name: MedTerms
tagline: Medical vocabulary study aid with a free browser quiz and iPhone/iPad flashcards for roots, prefixes and suffixes. Its website also advertises Android, but the linked Google Play listing was unavailable at review.

name: KissingAI
tagline: Creates short, non-explicit kissing-scene videos from two separate portraits of consenting adults, using a template and a preview-frame confirmation step. Output is synthetic media.

name: AI GIF Editor
tagline: Browser GIF toolkit with local crop, resize, timing and compression, plus credit-based AI generation and remixing. Spot editing and consistent characters are still marked coming soon.

name: Raphael AI
tagline: Polish-language AI image, photo-editing and video studio with model-specific credit rates and one-time packs. Public budget estimates help compare generation settings before purchase.

name: WorkshopWorth — Free Laser Product Pricing Calculator
tagline: Editable laser-product pricing worksheet covering materials, labor, machine time, overhead, packaging and selling fees. Outputs are assumption-based estimates, not market-tested prices.

name: FreeAI Go
tagline: Curated directory of AI tools, courses and resources with task filters, access notes and a side-by-side shortlist. AI processing happens on linked providers, not in this directory.

name: Product Grid AI
tagline: Creates AI product-photo concept sheets from one product image, with four or nine compositions in a chosen art direction. A separate local splitter cuts existing grids into tiles.

name: Robotics Lab
tagline: Interactive 3D robotics lessons with guided wiring, sample-code behavior and board-identification quizzes. Educational models, not electrical-safety validation or a full hardware simulator.

name: supereo
tagline: AI-visibility workspace offering tracked prompts, content-change workflows and an MCP connection. It advertises automated site fixes and off-site visibility work, not guaranteed recommendations.

name: ImageMuse
tagline: Browser image-editing tools for enhancement, backgrounds, upscaling and prompt-based changes. Standard guest use is limited; premium models and further edits use credits.

name: ListDolly
tagline: Turns property photos into real-estate video reels with planned camera moves, room ordering and branded or unbranded outputs. Listing-link import and a music library are still coming soon.

name: The AI Tools
tagline: Searchable software directory with task-based guides, pricing models, sources and limitations. Makers can submit free listings or buy placement.

name: SpeakerEject
tagline: Browser audio tools for left/right channel checks, reference tones and downloadable surround samples. Also offers a water-eject tone with stated limits, not a device-repair guarantee.

name: ShipShaper Speed Test Comparison
tagline: Independent ShipShaper game calculator comparing three timed runs per build. Reports baseline and modified medians, seconds saved and percentage time reduction.

name: GameReleases.io
tagline: Video-game release calendar with month and platform filters for PC, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch. Uses community-maintained IGDB data.

name: Bazi Calculator
tagline: Four Pillars astrology calculator with birth-city and solar-time adjustments, chart explanations and optional AI interpretation reports. Traditional reflection, not scientific prediction.

name: Remove Watermark from Video
tagline: Browser video editor that rebuilds areas covered by watermarks or text overlays in footage you own or have rights to edit. Processing uses servers and third-party providers.

name: ReLimit Monitor
tagline: Mac companion for Codex account limits and reset times. Smart Mode ranks saved accounts by capacity and freshness. Only the signed-in account updates live; other readings are saved.

name: Magi2AI
tagline: Independent browser video generator with scene prompts, optional reference images, duration and format controls, and a sound setting. Generated clips use credits.

name: Remove Music From Video
tagline: Separates voices from a video soundtrack, with cleaned MP4, voice and music downloads. Video stays on-device, but extracted audio and sampled safety frames go to servers.

name: Vivify
tagline: Browser-based realtime webcam effects with Face Swap, Try-On and Restyle modes. A separate desktop client supplies a virtual camera for compatible streaming and meeting apps.

name: ModuMath
tagline: Math practice pilot with typed or photographed questions, worked explanations and related exercises in English, Korean and Simplified Chinese.

name: PanaCalc Pallet Carton Count Calculator
tagline: A free pallet-planning calculator for identical upright cartons in uniform columns. It compares two footprint orientations, complete layers and the entered payload limit, then shows the count and formula.

name: Flying Car AI
tagline: A photo-to-video tool for putting an authorized adult or a car into a flying-car scene. Choose one of four scenarios, optionally supply a car image, and request a 15-second clip with sound.

name: Zanta AI
tagline: An independent browser studio for generating images and videos from text or reference images, with model selection and photo-effect presets. Credit cost depends on the model and output settings.

name: Gemini Reset
tagline: An independent tracker of public Gemini quota-reset announcements for Google Antigravity, with linked sources, an event archive, local-time views and guidance for finding your own refill time. It cannot reset an account.

name: Image to Image
tagline: A prompt-based photo editor for restyling or changing an existing image. Load up to three reference images, describe the edit, and choose a speed or quality mode; templates supply a sample photo and starting prompt.

name: SpriteAI
tagline: A browser workspace for making animated sprite sheets from prompts or reference images, with frame editing and export options. It also has free local tools for slicing existing sheets and converting GIFs or video frames.

name: Ilm Tools
tagline: An English-language collection of 70 Islamic calculators, counters, checklists and reference pages, including Zakat, prayer-time and calendar tools. Coverage mixes interactive tools with educational guides.

name: Tokvane
tagline: A free directory for comparing 246 crypto software tools across market data APIs, on-chain analytics, trading bots, terminals and portfolio trackers. Profiles show dated sources, pricing and interface details.

name: Sonvori
tagline: Sonvori is a browser music workspace for creating songs or instrumentals from descriptions and lyrics, with audio, voice and music-video tools. Some local helpers prepare a brief; cloud music generation uses credits.

name: Nonograms
tagline: A browser picture-logic game with 12 boards: eight 5x5 and four 10x10 puzzles. Fill or cross out squares using row and column clues, with hints and undo. This is a finite collection, not a daily puzzle service.

name: BannerPixel
tagline: Browser banner-design tool for Minecraft with layered pixel patterns, shield preview, Java command text and image export controls. It is an independent fan tool, not a playable copy of the game.

name: AI Generator Hub
tagline: Web workspace for AI video, image, music and voice drafts using credit-based plans. Video controls support text prompts, image frames, aspect ratio and seed settings; a login is required to generate.

name: MedicareBrackets
tagline: Independent U.S. Medicare premium tables and calculators for comparing income-related Part B and Part D adjustments. It separates premium years and tax-income years, with links to agency sources.

name: ToolMarina
tagline: Small directory of web tools with category browsing, search and product-detail pages. It also offers an llms.txt generator and a Domain Rating lookup. Review badges are the site owner's own assessments.

name: Vicelet
tagline: Free browser quiz with 21 statements and scores across seven traditional vice themes. It offers a result card and reflection prompts for entertainment, not a psychological diagnosis or religious assessment.

name: ASL Translator
tagline: Browser ASL learning resource with letter-by-letter fingerspelling, an alphabet reference and a video sign dictionary. The text converter is a practice aid, not a full English-to-ASL grammar translator.

name: Creative App Finder — Craft Apps Guide
tagline: A guided finder for ArtCraft creative apps based on task, starting file, handoff, operating system and offline needs. It suggests an app and checks to make, not certified compatibility or a download.

name: Frame Mischief Crop Check
tagline: Browser tool for planning a portrait crop from wide video. Mark setup, action and reaction positions, preview fixed or moving framing, and prepare a comparison image or FFmpeg filter for your editor.

name: AI Handwriting Remover by Web Document Scanner
tagline: Web Document Scanner offers an AI tool for removing handwriting and pen marks from document images. It is intended to make reusable blank copies; review the result for lost print or lines before using it.

name: Supplement Cost-per-Serving Calculator
tagline: Compares capsule or tablet supplement costs per labeled serving using total price, bottle count, units per bottle and units per serving. It compares price only, not quality, health benefit or dosage.

name: Deepcut Duel
tagline: Browser trivia game with five daily questions, unlimited practice and asynchronous friend challenges. Correct answers earn points using preset familiarity tiers, rather than live player rarity.

name: Fractional COO Capacity Calculator
tagline: Client-capacity calculator for fractional COOs and operations consultants. Adjust weekly hours, client scope, retainers and target utilization to estimate portfolio headroom and illustrative revenue.

name: Tool5
tagline: Browser toolkit for image editing, PDF merging/splitting, Markdown preview, regex testing and text encoding. Advertises local processing without registration.

name: GuruTrans
tagline: Browser translation, style-rewriting and text-encoding tools, including historical-language aids and Morse/binary converters. Important language output needs review; some operations require an account.

name: AirMusic
tagline: AI song maker with text, lyric and humming inputs, plus cover, extension, stem and music-video tools. Creation uses account credits; generated songs are public by default unless changed.

name: Arcanumber: Work out your Life Path number with every step shown, or draw a tarot spread
tagline: Arcanumber pairs numerology calculators with tarot spreads and astrology charts, which run in the browser and show how each result was worked out. Longer readings written by an AI model are an optional extra for signed-in users.

name: BeadColor: Turn a photo into a fuse bead pattern and fix single beads before you print
tagline: BeadColor converts photos and pixel art into fuse bead patterns matched to the colours of a bead brand. A browser editor lets you change the pattern by hand, and an AI generator can redraw a photo in a cartoon style first.

name: ChatSequel: Let long ChatGPT answers carry on without typing "Continue" after every reply
tagline: ChatSequel is a Chrome extension for ChatGPT that sends your follow-up message once a reply has finished. A second function summarises a long chat and carries the summary into a new one.

name: CursiveFont: Type a name or a short line and copy it in script letters that paste into any app
tagline: CursiveFont turns typed words into 24 styles of Unicode letters, script and bold as well as decorated, that copy and paste like ordinary text. Further pages set a name or a short passage in a handwriting font and export it as an image.

name: Dokima: Have an AI reviewer hunt for security holes in your code and double-check each finding
tagline: A command-line program for Linux and macOS that reviews your Git repositories for security weaknesses with the AI model you choose. Findings are checked a second time and written into a local HTML report with suggested fixes.

name: FaceAnalysis: Compare up to five photos of yourself by score before you pick a profile picture
tagline: A web tool that gives each uploaded face photo a score from 1 to 10 and estimates the face shape. The scoring model was trained on photos rated by people, and a separate report adds styling advice.

name: FindMates: Find teammates for ranked, casual or co-op games before you queue with strangers
tagline: FindMates is a looking-for-group site where players post what they play and who they want to play with. Others browse those posts by game, then follow each other and plan a session in chat.

name: Fiscly: Ask an Australian tax question at any hour, then find a registered accountant nearby
tagline: A chat assistant for general questions on Australian tax and accounting, next to a directory of accounting firms in every state and territory. The directory is built from the public register of the Tax Practitioners Board.

name: Ganjiday: See your Chinese birth chart with the calendar and time zone details worked out
tagline: Ganjiday calculates BaZi and Zi Wei Dou Shu birth charts in the browser from a birth date, time and city. The site adds compatibility tables and a tarot spread, and an AI model writes longer readings as an option.

name: GIFCrop: Cut an animated GIF to a circle or square so it fits a profile picture slot
tagline: GIFCrop crops animated GIFs to a circle or a square inside the browser and keeps the animation's speed. The same site holds further GIF editors and a paid generator that makes GIFs from a text description.

name: HokuHost: Register a domain with a small website on it, or let your AI assistant do the buying
tagline: HokuHost registers domain names in 51 endings and includes shared hosting for a website and email on each one. Searching, ordering and nameserver changes also work through a REST API and an MCP server.

name: JPEG to PDF: Turn a pile of phone photos into one tidy PDF without sending them to a server
tagline: JPEG to PDF is a web tool that places each photo on a PDF page and saves the result as one file or as separate PDFs in a ZIP. The conversion runs in the browser tab.

name: Kaomoji Club: Pick a Japanese text face by mood and tap to copy it into a chat, bio or Discord message
tagline: Kaomoji Club is a browser library of kaomoji, the Japanese faces built from text characters. You search or filter by mood, then tap a face to copy it for a message or profile.

name: LoadVis: Check how your cartons fit into a shipping container and get a 3D loading plan
tagline: LoadVis calculates how cartons fit into a shipping container and shows the result as a 3D plan with a loading order. Cargo data can be typed in, pasted as shipment text or imported from an Excel file.

name: Magetoo: Sit a timed Tage Mage mock exam and see your estimated score out of 600
tagline: Magetoo is a French web app for practising the Tage Mage, the aptitude test many French business schools ask for. It runs full mock exams on the real timing and explains every answer.

name: MakeBeat: Program a drum pattern in the browser and have AI build a full instrumental around it
tagline: MakeBeat is a browser drum machine with an AI step that turns a pattern or a typed description into an instrumental. Studio tools split tracks into stems and convert audio to MIDI, and a mastering step finishes the result.

name: MRTFinder: Find an MRI practice in a German city that takes your insurance and books online
tagline: A German-language directory of MRI and radiology practices in Germany, searched by city and filtered by details like public insurance, online booking or Saturday hours. Every detail links to the source it was taken from.

name: NotebookLM Ultra Exporter: Get your NotebookLM notes, chats and flashcards out into Word, PDF or Anki
tagline: NotebookLM Ultra Exporter is an independent Chrome extension that saves content from Google's NotebookLM, now named Gemini Notebook, as files for other programs. It covers notes, chats, slides, flashcards, quizzes and mind maps.

name: Papaye: Get PDFs signed by email and share files by private link, with a CRM alongside
tagline: A set of eight business services, led by PDF signing by email and file sharing by private link. The rest includes a CRM and supplier invoice checks, as well as French company data.

name: PennyCompute: Cut, join and caption videos through an API instead of running your own FFmpeg server
tagline: PennyCompute is a hosted API for video jobs: converting, joining, mixing sound and burning in subtitles with FFmpeg, plus rendering Remotion projects. A dashboard runs the same jobs by hand.

name: Pepys Transcribe: Search and question a backlog of recordings as timestamped text
tagline: Pepys Transcribe converts audio and video files, cloud recordings and pasted links into timestamped transcripts in the browser. Each transcript comes with a summary and a chat that cites the moment an answer came from.

name: Pimg.pro: Line up photos side by side, stacked or in a grid without uploading them anywhere
tagline: Pimg.pro is a browser canvas for joining several pictures into one image or PDF. The pictures are processed on your own device, with cropping, resizing and batch editing alongside.

name: SciGalaxy: Map a research field from your database exports: who cites whom and which topics took off
tagline: SciGalaxy builds bibliometric maps in the browser from exports of Web of Science, Scopus, CNKI and other literature databases. It groups the papers into clusters and exports the figures for a thesis or journal paper.

name: Sidesly: Run your audition lines with an AI reader that speaks the other part and waits for you
tagline: Sidesly is a browser tool for actors that reads the other characters' lines aloud from a pasted or uploaded scene. It listens for the actor's pause before giving the next cue.

name: Signato: Take salon bookings online and get treatment consents signed on a tablet
tagline: Signato is a web app for salons and studios that combines an online booking calendar with questionnaires sent before the visit. Clients sign the consent for their treatment on a phone or tablet, and the document is kept in their record.

name: Snow Day Calculator: See the chance that school closes or opens late tomorrow, by US ZIP code
tagline: Snow Day Calculator estimates the chance of a school closure or delay for the next school day in a US school district. It works from the National Weather Service forecast and the area's normal winter.

name: Songyougive: Turn a shared memory into a song for one person and approve every line first
tagline: Songyougive writes song lyrics from a few memories you share about one person and records them with AI music and vocals. The song is given through a gift page with the lyrics, your message and a QR code.

name: SpeakerEject: Play a low tone to shake water out of a muffled phone speaker
tagline: SpeakerEject plays a low-frequency sweep through a phone's speaker, meant to move a water droplet off the grille. It runs in the browser, and the same site offers speaker, headphone and surround tests.

name: Sponsee: Keep every brand deal for your stream on one board and nudge sponsors who pay late
tagline: Sponsee is a browser app where live streamers track each sponsorship from the first brand message to the paid invoice. It also works out a rate range for a sponsored stream and drafts reminders for overdue invoices.

name: StagePeek: Find out roughly how far section 101, row A sits from the stage before the concert
tagline: A browser tool that shows where a concert seat sits in a 2D seating plan and a 3D model of the venue. An illustrated audience view previews the stage from that section at several phone zoom levels.

name: Summarize Images: Get copyable text plus a short summary from a screenshot or photographed page
tagline: Summarize Images reads the text out of a screenshot, photo or scan and writes a short English summary of it in the same run. Both can be copied or exported as TXT, DOC or PDF.

name: TaskPriced: Work out what an AI model will cost you per month before the invoice does it for you
tagline: TaskPriced estimates the monthly bill for AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta from the workload you enter. A second tool recomputes past spend from a usage export, and both run in the browser.

name: Test Page for Printer: Print a test sheet and work out why your printer leaves streaks or drops a colour
tagline: Printer test sheets as PDFs in Letter and A4, each with a QR code that opens a guide to reading the printout. Small browser tools check print scale and estimate gaps in a nozzle pattern from a photo.

name: Text Photo AI: Swap, remove or add words in a finished JPG or PNG when the design file is long gone
tagline: Text Photo AI is a browser editor for the words in a JPG or PNG. An AI model replaces or removes existing lettering, and a separate caption editor places new text on the photo by hand.

name: Tokvane: Put crypto trading bots, data APIs and terminals side by side on the same dated checklist
tagline: Tokvane is a directory that describes crypto trading bots, market data APIs, on-chain analytics, terminals and portfolio trackers with the same set of fields. Each block of a tool's card shows the day it was read and the vendor page it came from.

name: Turtle Noir: Solve yes-or-no mystery riddles with an AI as host, alone or in a room with friends
tagline: Turtle Noir is a browser game for lateral thinking puzzles, the riddles you solve by asking yes-or-no questions. An AI plays the host who knows the answer, for one player or a shared room.

name: VantageMDM: Set up, lock down and wipe your organisation's phones and tablets from a web panel
tagline: VantageMDM is mobile device management for organisations: an admin enrols devices remotely and sends them rules, apps and settings. It covers Android, Apple, Windows and Chromebook devices and includes a kiosk mode.

name: XZETO: Watch what your mouse, keyboard, mic or controller sends to the browser
tagline: XZETO is a set of browser tests for microphones, cameras, keyboards, mice, screens and game controllers. Each test starts on a button press and works without an account.
