tagline: Summarize YouTube Videos turns public video links into summaries, key points, timestamped chapters and transcripts. Its browser interface includes public examples and paid export features.

name: RoomGlint
tagline: RoomGlint generates room-redesign, virtual-staging, rendering and landscape concepts from uploaded images. Its browser tools use one shared credit balance.

name: PNG Snap
tagline: PNG Snap removes image backgrounds and offers related transparent-PNG tools. It uses local processing on supported computers and a third-party cloud route on other browsers.

name: StopScroll
tagline: StopScroll creates AI thumbnail directions from a YouTube URL or a title and prompt. Its browser workspace offers styles, optional subject images and several aspect ratios.

name: WarpSpeed VPN
tagline: WarpSpeed VPN manages a WireGuard VPN on your own Linux server. Its web console covers users, devices and routing, with SAML sign-on on Team and Business plans.

name: AI Photo Editor
tagline: AI Photo Editor is a browser interface for prompt-based photo edits and text-to-image creation. Choose among the site’s listed models, set image options and review a credit quote before generating.

name: Unslop UI
tagline: Unslop UI checks a webpage for repeated design patterns and returns a scored report with marked screenshots and suggested fixes. The score describes a visual style, not whether AI built the site.

name: FlossChart
tagline: FlossChart converts photos into cross-stitch previews with DMC color references, stitch-count controls and confetti cleanup. Paid print packs offer tiled charts and a thread list.

name: Flux3Max.io
tagline: Flux3Max.io is an independent browser video generator offering text and image inputs, duration and resolution controls, and credit-priced output. It uses FLUX 3 Max branding but is not an official provider site.

name: IT Tools Collection
tagline: IT Tools Collection is a browser toolbox for formatting, converting and inspecting developer data. Its catalog includes JSON, text, configuration, network and image utilities.

name: Clean Audio
tagline: Clean Audio cleans voice recordings and video soundtracks in a browser. The free workflow offers original/cleaned comparison, adjustable noise reduction and MP3 or WAV export.

name: AIDanceVideo
tagline: AIDanceVideo offers portrait-to-dance clips from solo and two-photo choreography templates. Its paid browser workflow advertises 720p MP4 output, with account-based render history.

name: BotChatAI
tagline: BotChatAI offers website-trained chatbots for support, product questions and lead capture. Owners verify a domain and review source pages before installing a Custom HTML widget.

name: 365 My Life
tagline: 365 My Life turns a goal and available time into an editable weekly outline using authored prompts. Its sample covers personal life, career and ministry, with optional account-based saved planning.

name: Fermi Game
tagline: Fermi Game is a browser estimation puzzle with a shared daily five-question deck, practice modes and a logarithmic answer dial. Points depend on how close a guess is to the game's reference value.

name: Roadster AI
tagline: Roadster AI sells preset comedy videos made from a permitted person or pet photo. Choose a driving scene and output quality; its reference clips illustrate the scene, not verified customer results.

name: LayerSplit
tagline: LayerSplit separates a flat design into named image layers and a filled background. Its AI split workflow is complemented by sample layer editing and free browser tools for existing PSD files.

name: Purupuru Maker
tagline: Purupuru Maker is an independent browser image-animation tool. Paint a motion mask on a still image, preview a wobble and encode a GIF or supported video format.

name: Zupio
tagline: Zupio offers original browser games, including Only the King, a castle physics puzzle where a marble must topple guards without knocking down the king. A second action game is marked as a development build.

name: MARCO Chat
tagline: MARCO Chat is an iPhone messaging app for direct conversations, groups, voice calls and media sharing. Its store listing describes QR, invite-link and handle-based connections.

name: NumUtility
tagline: NumUtility offers free browser calculators and unit converters for everyday arithmetic, dates and measurements. Its main calculators show the formula used for the selected inputs.

name: EzRemove.pl
tagline: EzRemove.pl is a Polish-language photo-editing studio for background removal, object erasing and image enlargement. It offers shared one-time credits and publishes per-tool costs.

name: AI Rap Video
tagline: AI Rap Video turns permitted photos into short staged music clips with generated lyrics and sound. Its creator offers scene-specific 10- or 15-second formats and shows credit costs before generation.

name: Pool Care Calculators
tagline: Pool Care Calculators offers browser estimates for pool volume, pump flow, heating cost and water-chemistry adjustments. Each tool shows assumptions and formula notes alongside retesting reminders.

name: IQInsight
tagline: IQInsight offers a timed online reasoning exercise with spatial, numerical, logical and applied questions. Free results use a provisional score scale; an optional paid report explains an attempt.

name: Cadri Commander
tagline: Cadri Commander is a Windows file manager with dual-pane navigation, file previews, PDF and Markdown tools, Git views and remote connections. Optional indexing and AI can search folders you allow.

name: clatterclub.com
tagline: Clatter Club teaches American and Hong Kong mahjong through lessons, guided computer practice and online tables. Its American game uses its own Clatter Card of winning hands, not the NMJL card.

name: iMATHgine™ Beta Mix — Thai/English Equation Answer Checker
tagline: iMATHgine Beta Mix checks a proposed x by substituting it into supported one-step and two-step equations. It shows both side values, supports English and Thai, and links to teacher activities.

name: Litebackup
tagline: Litebackup backs up live SQLite databases to a self-hosted server and an encrypted cloud bucket. It offers point-in-time restore, readonly replicas and database handoff through a CLI or SDK.

name: Koinote
tagline: Koinote is a Markdown writing workspace with inline rendering, cloud documents, image hosting and exports. Optional Lifetime membership adds storage, version history and scoped agent access.

name: Nexim
tagline: Nexim is a transcript-based browser video and podcast editor. It advertises local transcription, cuts, word replacement and exports, with separately priced cloud processing and sync.

name: DocMate: PDF Scanner & OCR
tagline: DocMate is an iPhone and iPad document app for scanning, organizing, OCR and PDF review. Optional Pro tools include PDF comparison, supported searchable exports and other advanced workflows.

name: EveryAITrend
tagline: EveryAITrend offers photo-cast video templates with preset timing, roles and reference audio. Each template shows required photo slots, duration and a credit cost before paid generation.

name: Magi-2 Video
tagline: Magi-2 Video is an independent image and video workspace with text prompts, reference-frame options and photo-cast effects. Available model choices and credits determine each generation.

name: Sekuon | سكون
tagline: Sekuon is an Arabic and English browser voice journal with a temporary guest recording preview. Accounts add saved notes and optional community sharing; it is not therapy or an emergency service.

name: Poptin MCP
tagline: Poptin MCP connects a Poptin account to compatible AI assistants for popup and form management, performance questions, audience segments and email-campaign preparation. Access depends on account permissions.

name: RetireGrowth
tagline: RetireGrowth offers educational FIRE and retirement calculators with adjustable savings, spending and growth assumptions. Charts and methodology pages explain modeled targets and paths.

name: DLE Arena
tagline: DLE Arena combines a daily-game directory with its own Arena Rank puzzle. Rank five items by a stated rule, check positions and continue through three rounds, with additional topic practice.

name: Abfig: Draft the summary picture a journal wants from your abstract, sized to its rules
tagline: Abfig drafts a graphical abstract from a pasted abstract or an uploaded sketch and sizes it to a journal preset. The draft is changed by text instruction or by brushing over one area, then exported as TIFF or PNG.

name: AdMapix: Search the ads rival apps, games and shops are running and get AI reports on them
tagline: AdMapix is a searchable library of ads run by mobile apps, games and online shops, with filters for advertiser, country, channel and format. AI tools break down single ads and write research reports with linked sources.

name: Agents Kart: Collect applications through one link and get resumes ranked against your job criteria
tagline: Agents Kart is a platform of AI agents for repetitive office work, and its Resume Screener is the one marked as live. It scores incoming resumes against a job description and shows the evidence behind each ranking.

name: AI GIF Maker: Cut a few seconds of video into a looping GIF, or have AI draw one from a sentence
tagline: A browser tool that turns a short part of an MP4 or WebM video into a GIF on your own device. It also makes GIFs from a text prompt or a photo with an AI image model, and compresses GIFs you already have.

name: ai-logo.net: Get six logo concepts for your business name and see them on a cup before you buy
tagline: ai-logo.net draws logo concepts from a business name, an industry, a style and colours, six per round. Each concept is previewed on backgrounds and mockups, and the finished logo downloads as PNG or SVG.

name: Almenar: Draw your key numbers as a tree and follow a drop down to the figure that caused it
tagline: Almenar is a web app for building metric trees, diagrams that link a goal such as revenue to the figures that move it. Values come from PostHog, Google Sheets or CSV files, and a finished tree can be presented as slides or shared by link.

name: Band Score Checker: Paste an IELTS practice essay and see which band it would likely get, and why
tagline: Band Score Checker estimates the band of an IELTS writing answer on each of the four marking criteria and corrects the most serious mistakes. It reads typed essays, chart reports, letters and photos of handwritten pages.

name: BookCoverAI: Get a book cover with front, spine and back sized for your page count on Amazon KDP
tagline: BookCoverAI draws a book cover from your title, genre and a description of the scene. It exports a front cover for ebooks or a full wrap PDF for Amazon KDP paperbacks and hardcovers.

name: Chatflow.co: Train a chat agent on your website and files so it answers the routine support questions
tagline: Chatflow builds an AI chat agent from a company's own website and documents and puts it on the site as a chat widget. A visitor who asks for a person is passed to the team's inbox or Slack.

name: China in Hand: Check if your passport needs a visa for China and look up trains before you fly
tagline: China in Hand is a travel site with a visa checker by passport and a train lookup for mainland China. Guides on Alipay, WeChat Pay and foreign cards sit next to the two tools.

name: Coach and Staff Pay: Work out what each coach is owed from the sessions they ran in Wix Bookings
tagline: Coach and Staff Pay is an app for Wix sites that turns the sessions in Wix Bookings into pay for each coach or staff member. It is built for clubs and academies that pay by the session.

name: DeskWink: Let ChatGPT or Claude work on the files, browser and commands of your own computer
tagline: DeskWink links cloud AI apps to a Windows PC or Mac through one remote MCP connector. The AI can then read and edit local files, run commands and use the browser, with an activity record and backups of changed files.

name: DiemWise: Work out a travel allowance day by day and see the rate behind every amount
tagline: A per diem calculator that prices each day of a business trip with the official US rate for that city and date. The Android app applies the allowance rules of Germany, France and Spain as well.

name: FaceAnalysis.app: Measure your face shape, symmetry and proportions without uploading the photo
tagline: A set of browser tools that measure face shape, symmetry and proportions from one front-facing photo. The measuring runs on your own device, and sending the photo anywhere is an optional extra step.

name: FastScribe: Turn a recording or a public video link into an editable transcript and subtitles
tagline: FastScribe converts audio files, video files and public social video links into text with a timestamp on every sentence. You correct the transcript in the browser and export it as a document, a spreadsheet or an SRT subtitle file.

name: FormResizer: Get a signature or photo to the exact KB and pixel size an application form demands
tagline: A browser tool that resizes a signature or photo to the file size and dimensions an online application form asks for. It checks the finished JPG against your target before you download it.

name: Fyslide: Write a batch of TikTok photo slideshows from one topic, on your own computer
tagline: Fyslide is a desktop app that makes TikTok photo slideshows and Instagram carousels from a design and a topic. The text comes from an AI account you connect yourself, and the finished slides export as images or post to TikTok.

name: GifBunny: Turn a sentence or one picture into a looping GIF for chats and stickers
tagline: A browser tool that draws a short looping GIF from a written description or one uploaded picture. Two standalone tools shrink existing GIFs to a target size on your device.

name: HEICtoJPGer: Turn iPhone HEIC photos into JPG or PNG copies without sending them anywhere
tagline: HEICtoJPGer converts HEIC and HEIF photos from an iPhone into JPG or PNG files inside the browser. Batches download as a ZIP, and location and camera data are removed from the copies.

name: InteriorStage: See your empty room furnished in several styles before the first sofa is ordered
tagline: InteriorStage adds furniture and decor to a photo of an empty room in a style you choose. Finished concepts can be turned into short videos to share.

name: Kivo Studio: Try AI video shots as small drafts, then render the best one in 4K
tagline: Kivo Studio is a web studio for AI images, video and audio that works in drafts and finals. A browser editor lets an AI assistant cut the timeline alongside you.

name: LocalASO: See where your app ranks for each search phrase in every country's App Store
tagline: LocalASO is a Mac app for App Store keyword research that checks search phrases country by country and keeps the results on your own computer. It also scores name and subtitle options and can fill a draft version in App Store Connect.

name: MacroDial: See in one daily score whether US economic conditions have shifted
tagline: MacroDial gathers public US economic and market data into a daily dashboard with one score from 0 to 100. Seven modules and the single data series under them show where a change came from.

name: makemods.app: Build a Minecraft mod in the browser by describing it, then edit it as a graph
tagline: makemods.app builds Minecraft mods in the browser from a chat description and shows the result as an editable node graph. Finished mods export for Java Edition or Bedrock Edition.

name: Miraga: Plan a story in episodes and storyboard panels, then generate its video and audio
tagline: Miraga is an AI studio for images, video and audio, built around story projects with episodes and storyboard panels. A quick mode makes a single clip from a photo or a typed description.

name: MP3Craft: Make MP3 copies of WAV, FLAC or M4A recordings without uploading them
tagline: MP3Craft converts WAV, FLAC, M4A, OGG and AAC files to MP3 inside the browser, one file or a batch at a time. You pick the bitrate, and the audio stays on your device.

name: NAGROYA ERP: Run accounting, VAT returns, payroll and stock for a UAE company, in Arabic or English
tagline: NAGROYA ERP is a cloud system for companies in the UAE that covers accounting, tax returns, HR, payroll and inventory. It runs in Arabic and English in the browser and installs on a phone as an app.

name: No Trace Share: Choose which hidden details leave a photo or document, then check the cleaned copy
tagline: A browser tool that shows the hidden data in photos, PDFs and Office files and lets you decide field by field what to remove. It builds a separate copy and inspects that copy again before the download.

name: NosHost: Find out why a website or its email stopped working, one check at a time
tagline: NosHost is a set of web checks for DNS records, email authentication, certificates, redirects and technical SEO. Each result comes with an explanation of the finding and a pointer to the next fix.

name: One More Item: Snap everyday objects with your camera and collect them as pixel-art items
tagline: One More Item is an iPhone and iPad game that names the objects you photograph and turns them into pixel-art collectibles. Players fuse items into new ones and follow a new hunt list each day.

name: PicTempo: Line up a handful of photos into a slideshow video with music, in the browser
tagline: A browser editor that turns 2 to 24 photos into an MP4 slideshow with timing, transitions and background music. A second mode uses AI to animate a single photo from a written description.

name: PlanArt: Turn a list of rooms or a rough sketch into a floor plan picture you can argue about
tagline: PlanArt generates floor plan images from a room list, plot dimensions or an uploaded sketch. A manual editor for walls, doors and furniture exports to formats that design and CAD programs open.

name: Pollen Atlas: Look up today's pollen level for your town before you open the window
tagline: Pollen Atlas shows a daily pollen index for towns worldwide, split into tree, grass and weed pollen, with a five-day forecast. The site also has a pollen map, an air quality lookup and a directory of US allergy specialists.

name: Record to Notes: Transcribe recordings in your browser, with the audio staying on your device
tagline: Record to Notes transcribes audio and video files inside the browser tab and labels who is speaking. Transcripts can be corrected on the page and saved as text, subtitle or Markdown files.

name: RemoveMate: Lift a person or a product out of its background, or erase an old caption
tagline: RemoveMate removes the background from a photo in the browser and shows a preview before you download the cutout. Further tools erase text or a watermark from your own pictures and sharpen blurry ones.

name: Rent Ledger Hub: Keep a rent ledger with a running balance and hand it over as a PDF or Excel file
tagline: Rent Ledger Hub is a browser tool for US landlords that records rent, fees and payments month by month and keeps the balance. The ledger exports as a PDF statement, an Excel workbook or a CSV file.

name: Scandora: Scan paper, then search your documents and ask them questions with sources
tagline: Scandora is a scanner app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android that makes paper, PDFs and photos searchable by their text. It reads the key fields from invoices and answers questions about your documents with links to the source pages.

name: SooperKanoon: Search Indian court judgments and Bare Acts, and follow who cited which case
tagline: SooperKanoon is a search engine for Indian law, covering court and tribunal judgments together with the text of Acts. Other tools write AI case briefs and send citation alerts.

name: Sprite Sheet Tool: Pack loose animation frames into a sprite sheet, or generate a walk from one image
tagline: Sprite Sheet Tool packs PNG frames or a GIF into a sprite sheet for 2D games and cuts existing sheets back into frames, all in the browser. A separate AI generator turns one character image into a walk animation facing four directions.

name: SubtitleCo: Fix the wording and timing of an SRT or VTT subtitle file without uploading it
tagline: SubtitleCo is a browser editor for subtitle files you already have, in SRT or basic WebVTT format. You correct text and timestamps and check the result against a video from your own computer.

name: Talking Pet App: Make your dog or cat say the words you type, or sing a song, from a single photo
tagline: Talking Pet App turns one photo of a pet into a short video in which its mouth moves to a voice or a song. It runs in the browser and takes pets only, with photos of people excluded.

name: VectorDose: Grab a company's logo as a clean SVG or transparent PNG without signing up
tagline: A searchable library of company logos, each offered as a vector file and as a PNG with a transparent background. A second tool on the site shrinks photos to a file size limit in the browser.

name: Waiver.com: Collect signed waivers by link or QR code and find them by name at check-in
tagline: Online waiver software for activity businesses: guests sign from a link, or at the door from a QR code or a tablet. Staff look up the signed record by participant or booking.

name: AcaDraw: Type what your science figure should show, then fix it by drawing arrows on it
tagline: AcaDraw generates scientific illustrations from a text prompt and revises them from notes you draw onto the image. It also builds diagrams that open in draw.io or Excalidraw and converts images to SVG.

name: AnyRedact: Remove personal details from files and recordings before you share them
tagline: AnyRedact is a browser tool that finds personal details in documents, scans, pictures and audio recordings and removes them from the copy you download. You check every match before the export.

name: Atlas Verified: Check a supplier's certificates against official registers before goods or money move
tagline: Atlas Verified checks suppliers and their certificates against official registers and sanctions lists. AI agents also follow shipments and stock, and report what they find for a person to review.

name: Axlyne: Read your car's fault codes with your phone and keep a record for the mechanic
tagline: Axlyne is a phone app that reads a car's stored trouble codes through an OBD2 adapter and saves each scan per vehicle. It also keeps service history, expenses and a mileage log.

name: Cuff: Log a week of home blood pressure readings and hand your doctor a tidy PDF
tagline: A phone app for writing down blood pressure readings from your own monitor over a seven-day plan. At the end it builds a PDF report you can share with a doctor.

name: CVPizza: Check whether hiring software can read your CV, then tailor it to the job posting
tagline: CVPizza checks a PDF or Word CV for how well applicant tracking software can read it and compares it with a job posting. With an account it rewrites the CV for that posting and drafts a matching cover letter.

name: Dear Moment: Keep family photos and voice notes in a private diary you share by invite
tagline: Dear Moment is a phone app for saving family moments as photos, videos, text and voice recordings on a dated timeline. You decide for each entry whether it stays private or goes to invited relatives.
